# 03-deps — review a dependency bump

One run is one Dependabot pull request: npm dev dependencies or GitHub Actions. The outcome is a recommendation a person acts on: merge, hold with a reason, or close.

Stages; inputs, outputs and checks are in [CONTEXT.md](CONTEXT.md):
